verdict.rationale: TruffleHog has dedicated documentation for pre-commit hooks with a concrete git-based invocation (`--since-commit HEAD --results=verified,unknown --fail`), guidance for repo-wide setup via core.hooksPath, Husky integration, pre-receive hook alternatives for git servers, and even documents the bypass flag (--no-verify), showing mature first-class support for this workflow. Probe evidence confirms the CLI runs headlessly and exits non-zero on findings, which is required for hook enforcement.
